examples.note: hashlib exposes SHA-256 with an identical call shape to MD5 — this is a drop-in replacement, no new library needed. Note: MD5/SHA-1 are not a post-quantum concern (Grover's algorithm only halves effective hash strength, and SHA-256's 256-bit output is already comfortably above the quantum security threshold) — they are replaced here because they are classically broken/deprecated, not because of quantum risk.

Both the MGF1 mask-generation hash and the OAEP digest hash are upgraded together — do not delete or comment out the constant; a same-shape replacement using an already-imported hashes.SHA256 is available in this file (see the SHA256 class attribute above).
